title.zh: Bitcoin price metrics hint at rebound as $1.6B liquidations follow Binance hack
title.en: Bitcoin price metrics hint at rebound as $1.6B liquidations follow Binance hack

current_state.zh: Bitcoin held above $76,000 after touching $76,320 as markets absorbed a reported $6.3 billion Binance hack and a concurrent US tech-stock sell-off, with over $1.5 billion in crypto liquidations in 24 hours and four-hour RSI showing a bullish divergence.
